indications: SILENOR is indicated for the treatment of insomnia characterized by difficulty with sleep maintenance.  The clinical trials performed in support of efficacy were up to 3 months in duration .
contraindications: The dose of SILENOR should be individualized.
warningsAndPrecautions:

adverseReactions: Hypersensitivity to doxepin hydrochloride, inactive ingredients, or other dibenzoxepines. ( 4.1 ) Co-administration with Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitors (MAOIs): Do not administer if patient is taking MAOIs or has used MAOIs within the past two weeks.
